_metadata.collection_method: read-only GitHub CLI (gh v2.97.0), GraphQL API, and REST API queries
_metadata.sampling_limits: merge_group runs limited to 100 most recent; merged PRs limited to 50 most recent; open PRs targeting dev queried via gh pr list

queue_configuration_readback.command: gh api graphql -f query='{repository(owner:"alfloop-dev",name:"odayplus"){mergeQueue(branch:"dev"){id configuration{mergeMethod mergingStrategy checkResponseTimeout maximumEntriesToBuild maximumEntriesToMerge minimumEntriesToMerge minimumEntriesToMergeWaitTime}}}}'

local_policy_readback.note: Local policy.json values match remote readback for all merge_queue fields and required status checks contexts.

merge_group_check_runs_and_status_eviden.description: Per-SHA check runs and commit status evidence for a sampled merge_group commit ref, demonstrating how required contexts report on merge_group events

commit_statuses.description: PR #1206 approved by its assigned reviewer

merge_group_check_runs_and_status_eviden.conclusion: All 4 branch protection required contexts (orchestrator, product, product-e2e-gate via Actions check runs, and task-review-gate via commit status) report and pass on merge_group commits under ALLGREEN strategy.

ci_duration_minutes.calculation_method: Duration computed between createdAt and updatedAt for completed CI workflow runs excluding review-gate-only stamps (<1 min)

merge_throughput_analysis.source: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state merged --limit 50 --json number,headRefOid,mergedAt,createdAt,title
merge_throughput_analysis.command: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state merged --limit 50 --json number,headRefOid,mergedAt,createdAt,title
merge_throughput_analysis.note: Calculated from mergedAt timestamps across 50 consecutive merged PRs spanning 4.4 days (including weekend). Median interval between successive merges is 50.1 minutes.

open_pr_snapshot.source: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state open --json number,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,createdAt,updatedAt,title
open_pr_snapshot.command: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state open --json number,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,createdAt,updatedAt,title
open_pr_snapshot.note: Point-in-time snapshot of open PRs targeting dev. Note that PR age or check status does NOT establish whether a PR is actively queued in mergeQueue; instantaneous queue membership requires live GraphQL mergeQueue polling or webhook event streams.

queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.instantaneous_queue_depth: UNMEASURED_STATICALLY (Retrospective GitHub REST/run lists do not record continuous queue occupancy over time; workflow creation timestamps cannot be used to infer queue concurrency).
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.enqueue_to_merge_wait_time: UNMEASURED_STATICALLY (GitHub does not expose enqueue timestamp in pr/run list API).
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.assigned_collection_stage: WP-35B/C implementation and live observation window must collect continuous queue occupancy and enqueue-to-merge latency via active GraphQL polling or webhook telemetry.
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.measurement_conclusion: Retrospective data establishes that CI takes ~20.6 min (median) and merges occur on average every ~50 min (median gap). Instantaneous queue depth and waiting times remain unmeasured statically and are assigned to WP-35B/C.
